prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured reporting a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a retail center. Insured states the other vehicle backed into the driver's side rear quarter panel. No police report filed. Photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Photos received and reviewed. Visible damage to rear bumper cover and left quarter panel of insured vehicle. Other vehicle's driver exchanged information at the scene and is identified in the file. Liability appears probable against the other driver based on the account given. Recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 3: Claimant has reported neck pain consistent with whiplash following the collision. Claimant is now represented by counsel, and all further contact is to go through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and logged. Medical authorization request sent to counsel.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspected at an approved repair facility. Estimate received and under review. Rental coverage confirmed for the insured while repairs are pending. Counsel's office has requested medical records and a summary of treatment to date; request acknowledged.

Entry 5: Medical records received from the treating provider and under review for consistency with the reported mechanism of injury. Adjuster notes that the bodily injury claim is pending evaluation and will not be discussed directly with the claimant. Reserve reviewed and adjusted. Supervisor notified of represented claimant and open injury component.
